{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABXicagQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhBGjK8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 117, "title": "Simplify graph translation UI and prepare processor model weights on Save", "body": "## Problem

The extension Graph Editor exposes redundant translation-specific UI and implementation-history terminology instead of letting users compose Node graphs directly:

- The palette labels the reusable `PairedTextFormatter` as **"Paired text formatter (compatibility)"**. This is internal implementation history, not useful to users.
- **Graph actions → Translation preset** duplicates behavior that can be expressed with OPUS-MT, PairedTextFormatter and LiveTextDisplay Nodes, and globally switches existing translation branches. It is confusing with multiple independent graph paths.
- Optional OPUS-MT/TTS model weights currently require users to discover Models → Download / retry manually, even after they intentionally select a processor Node and Save their graph. This makes valid saved graphs unexpectedly unable to run offline.

## Expected outcome

- Display the Node as **Paired text formatter** everywhere in the Graph Editor palette/canvas/help, keeping the `PairedTextFormatter` type, output contracts, stored graphs and legacy migrations unchanged.
- Remove Translation preset from Graph actions and its editing controls; retain direct adding, wiring and individual processor settings. No hidden global translator switch is required for normal graph use. Leave existing saved graphs unchanged.
- On **successful valid Save graph**, automatically prepare any missing verified optional **model weights** required by saved OPUS-MT Japanese→English/English→Japanese, Supertonic3 and Kokoro processor Nodes. Model identity/voice is derived from the actual saved Node types/settings; deduplicate repeated equivalent Nodes and reuse already verified cached assets.
- The extension's ASR models already packaged at build remain packaged; do not initiate unnecessary runtime downloads for those models. Never start capture, inference or Workers during Save.
- Model preparation runs *after graph persistence*, uses the existing pinned manifests/integrity-verifying `ModelAssetCache`, shows clear per-model status and byte progress in Graph Editor with cancellation/retry/Models recovery. Do not block or roll back graph storage if a download fails, and do not claim Ready for partial/corrupt/missing assets. Keep the model cache verification/no-runtime-download-during-recording policy intact.
- Saving a structurally valid graph with parked/unconnected Nodes remains permitted; model preparation follows saved model-bearing Nodes, not a separate global translation preference. Do not silently mutate graph routes or saved data.
- Remove/update obsolete UI/help/docs that instruct users to use Translation preset or require a manual Models download for newly saved graphs. Models can remain a diagnostics/retry/delete interface.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Graph Editor visibly shows "Paired text formatter" without "(compatibility)" and no Translation preset controls. Existing graphs still migrate/load/run.
- [ ] Saving a graph with English→Japanese OPUS-MT schedules just the English→Japanese asset set, not the opposite direction; saving with multiple model Node types/voices schedules each distinct set once.
- [ ] Saving a graph with no optional model Nodes never initiates model requests.
- [ ] Model preparation does not run before Save or when Save validation/storage fails; does not roll back successful Save on download failure, and clearly reports Ready/Error/Cancel and progress, with retry.
- [ ] Cache re-use, integrity verification, missing/corrupt retry and page teardown are safe and use the existing cache implementation; nothing starts inference/recording during preparation.
- [ ] Optional parked nodes and saved version 8 graphs remain compatible; manual Models recovery remains usable when preparation was interrupted.
- [ ] Relevant deterministic unit and packaged Extension UI tests/build are run, with any not-run checks honestly reported.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Context

`extension/graph.js`, `extension/graph-editor.js`, `extension/graph-page.js`, `extension/model-cache.js`, `extension/model-asset-cache.js`, `extension/tts-cache.js`, `docs/extension-model-cache.md`, `docs/extension-graph.md`, `docs/chrome-extension.md`, product vision #7 and existing graph freedom issue #115.
